verbatim_quote.original: خودت سایکل اتوپایلت رو برای این تسک اجرا کن اگر تایید شد منم تایید میکنم تسک رو ببند.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Run the autopilot cycle on this task yourself; if it passes I will approve closing it.

extracted_decision.summary: Manager orders Hands to run the QA-review autopilot cycle autonomously and promises closure approval on a pass.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager trusts the memorized QA-review cycle and wants verification without his involvement; approval is conditional on a pass.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Hands must be rigorous since approval is pre-committed on a pass verdict.
